scripts.dev: cross-env SEPILOTD_DESKTOP_RENDERER=next concurrently -n next,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:next" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:minimal: cross-env SEPILOTD_DESKTOP_RENDERER=next NEXT_PUBLIC_SEPILOTD_FEATURE_PROFILE=minimal concurrently -n next,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:next" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:next && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.pack: node -e "for(const t of ['.electron-builder/app', 'release']){try{require('fs').rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}" && pnpm run stage:app && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: node -e "for(const t of ['.electron-builder/app', 'release']){try{require('fs').rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}" && pnpm run stage:app && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: node -e "for(const t of ['.electron-builder/app', 'release']){try{require('fs').rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}" && pnpm run stage:app && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: node -e "for(const t of ['.electron-builder/app', 'release']){try{require('fs').rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}" && pnpm run stage:app && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: node -e "for(const t of ['.electron-builder/app', 'release']){try{require('fs').rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}" && pnpm run stage:app && electron-builder --win --dir && node ../../scripts/verify-no-source-leak.mjs ./release && node ../../scripts/pack-launcher.mjs --launcher tools/launcher/target/release/sepilot-launcher.exe --source packages/desktop/release/win-unpacked --out packages/desktop/release/sepilot-desktop.exe && node ../../scripts/verify-launcher-payload.mjs ./release/sepilot-desktop.exe && node ../../scripts/scan-desktop-artifacts.mjs ./release
